name: Mono no Aware
description:
Mono no Aware (物の哀れ) is a Japanese aesthetic concept describing the gentle sadness and deep appreciation of things that are fleeting and impermanent. It finds beauty in the temporary — falling cherry blossoms, fading light, a moment that can never return. The awareness that nothing lasts is what makes it precious.

GitHub: https://github.com/panlobby/mono-no-aware
